1
Housekeeping mission

Put housekeeping steps in order

20 points

Rearrange the five cards into the safest sequence. Drag cards vertically or use the arrow buttons.

Situation

A three-level OTC shelf must be cleaned before opening. Products are still on the shelf and a clean temporary tray is available.

Control points

  • Protect the worker and prepare approved materials first.
  • Keep medicines away from moisture and chemicals.
  • Do not restock a wet shelf.
  • Apply FEFO when returning products.
  1. Clean the shelfWork top to bottom with approved technique.
  2. Prepare materials and PPEGather approved supplies and use appropriate protection.
  3. Return products using FEFOFace products forward and keep labels visible.
  4. Secure medicines in a clean traySeparate products from the cleaning area.
  5. Observe contact and drying timeConfirm the shelf is dry and safe before restocking.
Arrange all five steps.

Receiving mission

Triage the supplier delivery

20 points
Delivery brief: Compare each card with PO-207. Accept only verified usable stock. A short delivery may be accepted only when the actual quantity is documented. Damaged units are segregated. Unlisted items or unresolved price/expiry differences are held for the pharmacist or authorized receiver.

✓ Accept and stock

3
Shelf-level planogram

Build an OTC family-wellness bay

30 points

Each card represents one facing. Fill all twenty numbered positions. Repeated products must remain together as a horizontal block.

Bay brief

  • Top: Allergy (2), Cough tablets (2), ORS (1).
  • Eye level: Paracetamol (2), Ibuprofen (2), Vitamin C (1).
  • Hand/reach: Adult cough syrup (2), Pediatric syrup (2), Antacid (1).
  • Lower: Topical cream (2), Antiseptic wash (2), First-aid kit (1).

Read left to right. Exact order and number of facings both count. Liquids and bulky items are kept below eye level.

4
Store-level planogram

Lay out the entire community drugstore

30 points
Your task: Place all eleven movable department/fixture cards into Zones A-K. Read the store from the back/staff side at the top toward the entrance and exit at the bottom. The dashed line is the customer loop and must remain open.

Store planning brief

1 · Start with fixed anchors

The entrance/exit is fixed at the front. Staff access is fixed at the back-left. Utility access is fixed at the back-right. These are not draggable.

2 · Build the professional-service zone

Place the prescription/pharmacist counter on the back wall. Put private consultation directly beside it. Put the stockroom in the back-left staff zone.

3 · Create supervised clinical categories

Place OTC medicines within the pharmacist's sightline. First aid must be beside OTC. Put the health-services kiosk on a quiet perimeter near consultation.

4 · Fill the customer-shopping floor

Use the three central gondolas for vitamins, personal care, and baby care. Keep baby care on the wider right-side bay for bulky packs and carts.

5 · Finish the front end

Place the promo endcap on the power aisle without blocking entry. Put checkout beside the exit with a clear view of the store.

How to play

  1. Enter your section and student name before starting.
  2. For cards, drag with a mouse or tap a card and then tap a destination. For Mission 1, drag vertically or use the arrow buttons.
  3. Check each mission for immediate feedback. Correct mistakes and retry; the latest score is recorded.
  4. The complete activity is worth 100 points and saves progress on the current device.

All products and layouts are simulated. No real medicines are needed.
